name: Shijiazhuang Zhengding International Airport
before:
The airport for Shijiazhuang, capital of Hebei province, and a hub for Hebei Airlines with bases for China United and Spring Airlines. It handled 12.014 million passengers in 2025.

The high speed rail link is what sets it apart. The Beijing to Guangzhou line passes about 3 km south of the terminal, and a free shuttle bus runs every 30 minutes between the terminals and Zhengding Airport railway station. A D or G series train reaches Shijiazhuang station in under 15 minutes.

The airport goes further than that to pull passengers in. It offers free train tickets to stations including Beijing West and Zhengzhou for people flying into Shijiazhuang, and reimburses the train fare for passengers who arrive by rail and leave by air. For a client whose real destination is Beijing, that is worth pricing against a Beijing arrival.

Five bus routes also serve the city, costing up to 20 yuan.

It is one of the few airports in China that could handle the Antonov An-225.
after:
The airport for Shijiazhuang, the capital of Hebei province. It is a base for Spring Airlines and handled 12.014 million passengers in 2025.

What sets it apart is the high speed rail link. Some trains on the Beijing to Guangzhou high speed line stop at the airport's own station, Zhengding Airport, a short ride from the terminals.

The Antonov An-225 cargo aircraft has flown in several times.
